entities.name: Tekle Hawariat Tekle Mariyam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tekle Hawariat Tekle Mariyam was an Ethiopian politician, aristocrat, playwright, director and intellectual. He was the primary author of the 16 July 1931 constitution of Ethiopia, which was influenced by the Japanese Meiji Constitution.
